test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct Speech.

She said that she had never encountered such behavior.

options.text: She said, "I never encounter such behavior."
She said, "I have never encounter such behavior."
She said, "I was never encountering such behavior."
She said, "I had never encountered such behavior."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she had never encountered such behavior.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"She had never encountered" becomes "I had never encountered"**
